title: Safai Saathi feature entry
description: One feature that crosses app boundaries. A feature is a JOURNEY: what the citizen, the driver and the office do, in order, and how one app hands over to the next. The collections and the callables are the machine layer. This is the layer that says why they exist. Without it, three apps each have a half and nobody can say which half is missing.

x-slice-states.missing: Nothing is specified for this app yet. The other apps are waiting on it.
x-slice-states.specified: The contract says what this app must do, and this app has not written it.
x-slice-states.built: The app has the code, but it is not connected to the real backend. It reads or writes mock data, or it writes to a field nobody reads.
x-slice-states.wired: The app talks to the real backend with the contract's shape. The data flows. It has not been proven end to end.
x-slice-states.verified: The scenario has been run and passed, at least in the simulator.

x-feature-states.designed: The feature entry exists. The slices are not all wired.
x-feature-states.partial: Some slices are wired. The journey breaks somewhere.
x-feature-states.connected: Every slice is wired. The journey works end to end.

id.description: The feature id. The file name is this id plus .json.

status.description: The state of the WHOLE feature. It is the WORST state of its slices. A feature with one missing slice is not connected.

journey.description: One sentence. Who does what, from start to finish. If it needs two sentences, the feature is two features.

steps.description: The journey in order. Each step names who acts, what they touch and HOW they touch it.

via.description: How the step happens. 'rule' means a direct Firestore write that the rules authorise. 'callable' means the client calls a Function. 'server-function' means no client is involved. 'fcm' means a push. 'seed' means the office or the seed script wrote it.

reads.description: The Firestore paths this step reads. Use collection/{id} or collection/{id}/sub.

contractRefs.description: Pointers into the contract. Use 'collection.schema.json#field', 'callables.json#callableName', 'enums.json#/$defs/name' or 'constants.json#group.KEY'.

slices.description: One slice per app that participates. The slice is the app's PART of this feature. This is the thing that is missing or built.

surface.description: WHERE in that app this slice lives. A file path, a screen id, or a function name. It must be findable.

dependsOn.description: The ids of the OTHER slices this one waits for. A slice that waits on a missing slice cannot be wired.

evidence.description: How we know the state. A commit, a file path, a test name, or a screenshot. A state without evidence is a guess.

blockedBy.description: The one thing that stops this slice from moving. A change id, a missing contract entry, a missing callable.

handoffs.description: Where one app hands over to another. A handoff with no producer is a broken link.

via.description: The mechanism. A Firestore path, a callable name, an FCM topic.

scenario.description: The check that proves the feature works. It must be runnable. A scenario that says 'the journey works' is not a scenario.

id.description: The test id. PRD-1 calls them L1, C1, E1.

tiers.description: Which verification tiers this scenario can run at. static is a grep or a type check. simulated is the Firestore emulator. live is real phones.

openQuestions.description: What a human must settle. One question per line. A feature with an open question is not designed.
